description: List Outlook tasks with status and due dates.

nextLink.description: Continue a previous listing: pass its `nextLink` value unchanged to fetch the next page. When set, the paging/filter arguments are taken from the link and ignored here.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. "brief": one line per item, `title — <ISO date or "no date"> — <status>`, at most 120 chars each, as `data` in the untrusted-content envelope; a line starting `-- ` is a note (`-- none` for an empty page; a title starting `-- ` or `\` gets one leading `\`); a last line `-- more` means another page exists (re-ask without "brief" for its nextLink). A brief status is the task's own (not started, in progress, completed, …).

name: outlook_list_tasks
